description: Expanding an unknown tuple gives the dynamic value
notes: The spec doesn't say how an unknown value expands. The tuple's type gives the number of elements, so each element could map to a parameter as an unknown string, which would give an unknown of the function's result type, a string. hashicorp/hcl returns the dynamic value for an expanded argument that is unknown or of the dynamic pseudo-type, before evaluating the other arguments or mapping them to parameters (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go).
